title: How a Sink P-Trap Works to Block Sewer Gas
description: A P-trap is a critical component of every sink drainage assembly designed to maintain a self-sealing liquid barrier. As waste water drains from the basin, gravity carries the bulk of the flow down the vertical tailpiece and through the curved trap dip. When the faucet turns off, a standing volume of clean water remains trapped in the lower bend. This standing water seal completely isolates the room's indoor environment from harmful sewer gases and odor rising from the main branch line. Proper installation requires maintaining correct dip depth and slope.

How a Sink P-Trap Works to Block Sewer Gas

A P-trap is a critical component of every sink drainage assembly designed to maintain a self-sealing liquid barrier. As waste water drains from the basin, gravity carries the bulk of the flow down the vertical tailpiece and through the curved trap dip. When the faucet turns off, a standing volume of clean water remains trapped in the lower bend. This standing water seal completely isolates the room's indoor environment from harmful sewer gases and odor rising from the main branch line. Proper installation requires maintaining correct dip depth and slope.
